explanation: Kalimat pasif (passive voice) digunakan ketika fokus utama adalah pada objek atau tindakan yang dilakukan, bukan pada siapa yang melakukan tindakan tersebut. Dalam bahasa Inggris, bentuk pasif dibentuk dengan menggunakan kata kerja 'be' (is, am, are, was, were, been, being) diikuti oleh past participle (kata kerja bentuk ketiga) dari kata kerja utama.
keyRules: Bentuk dasar: Subject + be + past participle (+ by + agent)
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Simple Present Tense, pasifnya: Subject + is/am/are + past participle.
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Simple Past Tense, pasifnya: Subject + was/were + past participle.
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Present Continuous Tense, pasifnya: Subject + is/am/are + being + past participle.
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Past Continuous Tense, pasifnya: Subject + was/were + being + past participle.
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Present Perfect Tense, pasifnya: Subject + has/have + been + past participle.
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Past Perfect Tense, pasifnya: Subject + had + been + past participle.
Jika kalimat aktif dalam Future Simple (will), pasifnya: Subject + will + be + past participle.
Kata 'by + agent' (pelaku) bersifat opsional. Gunakan jika pelaku penting atau perlu disebutkan.

examples.passive: The meal is cooked by the chef.

examples.active: They built the bridge last year.
examples.passive: The bridge was built by them last year.

examples.active: The students had finished the assignment before the deadline.
examples.passive: The assignment had been finished by the students before the deadline.

examples.active: The company will launch a new product.
examples.passive: A new product will be launched by the company.

commonMistakes: Menggunakan 'be' yang salah untuk tenses tertentu.
Menggunakan 'to be' + infinitive (misalnya: 'is to cook') alih-alih 'is cooked'.
Menyebutkan 'by + agent' padahal tidak perlu, atau sebaliknya.
ieltsTip: Dalam IELTS Writing Task 1 (Academic), kalimat pasif sangat umum digunakan untuk mendeskripsikan data, grafik, dan proses. Fokuslah pada apa yang terjadi pada data atau objek, bukan siapa yang membuatnya. Gunakan variasi tenses pasif untuk menunjukkan perubahan dari waktu ke waktu. Dalam Task 2, pasif bisa digunakan untuk memberikan opini yang lebih objektif atau ketika pelaku tidak diketahui/tidak relevan.

quiz.question: Change to passive voice: 'The students are writing the essays.'
options: The essays are writing by the students.
The essays are being written by the students.
The essays were written by the students.
The essays have been written by the students.
quiz.answer: The essays are being written by the students.

quiz.question: Change to passive voice: 'The government has implemented new policies.'
options: New policies has implemented by the government.
New policies have implemented by the government.
New policies have been implemented by the government.
New policies are implemented by the government.
quiz.answer: New policies have been implemented by the government.
